title: Resource-direct exact integer matrix solve
objective: For square dense ZZ resource systems, promote coefficient and right-hand matrices once to generated FmpqMatrix resources and delegate to fmpq_matrix_solve, eliminating augment-RREF and scalar extraction while preserving rational solution semantics and portable fallback.

handoff.summary: Square dense ZZ resource systems now promote the coefficient and right-hand matrices exactly once through generated fmpq_matrix_from_fmpz, solve once through generated fmpq_matrix_solve, deterministically close both temporary promotions, and return canonical QQ resource storage. Rectangular, mixed-ring, portable, and legacy representations retain their previous paths. Focused tests cover matrix and vector right sides, nonintegral solutions, singular consistent and inconsistent systems, rectangular free-variable semantics, dimension errors, huge skew integers, source immutability, native-disabled and N-API-forbidden execution, and generated-resource trace provenance. The 40x40 solve with eight right-hand sides measures 0.63-0.76 ms for solve itself and 1.35 ms including verification multiplication, down from about 88 ms and below the reported Sage result of about 4 ms.
next_steps: Integrate this branch into dense-qq-resources; no FFI declarations or compiler changes are required.
